comment: CHOKEPOINT / danger analysis of a generated layout (designer 2026-11-16; Tools/TrainingGround/src/levelgen/chokepoints.ts; docs/port/LEVELGEN_LAYERS_REPORT.md). The ground free space (walls + buildings + covers + the canal, as the squad simulator walks it) is sampled along the routes' nav paths, the start -> goals path and the street centre lines. A PLACE is a stretch that is narrow, cluttered, under a drop ambush or beside a hiding spot (tier 1), or strongly exposed to window fire / roof marksmen (tier 2). Its score 0..1 = min(1, sum of weights x values). Every threshold is here; the enemies' own numbers (drop heights, weapon ranges, sight, stealth) are READ from the game configs named in threats.*.source - only what those files do not hold has a default here (keys ending _default).

sampling.comment: step_m: the geometric sample step along a line. threat_step_m: every how many metres a sample is tested against windows / roofs / hiding spots. max_probe_m: farther than this to the nearest obstacle = open ground. skip_building_margin_cm: samples inside a building (+ this margin round it) are skipped - doors and rooms are not street chokepoints. edge_margin_cm: samples this close to the map edge are skipped (a street that ends at the edge is not a passage).

narrow.comment: Narrow passage: the structural corridor width (walls / buildings / large covers / the canal edge / a bridge's sides: nearest obstacle + the obstacle opposite it) below width_m. Value 0 at width_m .. 1 at full_width_m and less. fan_deg: the opposite side is probed with rays +- this angle (robust to a gate post seen at a slant).

clutter.comment: Cluttered street (a jam): within window_m of street, in a band half_band_m either side, at least min_obstacles covers AND at least blocked_fraction of the band's area under them; value 1 at full_obstacles / full_blocked_fraction. Or a squeezed lane: the free passage between covers (or a cover and a wall) under lane_width_m for lane_min_length_m and more.

canyon.comment: Canyon: both sides lined by tall objects (height >= tall_min_height_cm: buildings, 330 cm walls, silos) no farther than side_max_m each, on at least min_share of the stretch.

redundancy.comment: No alternative route: the stretch is blocked (block_radius_m round its samples) and the way from probe_m before it to probe_m after it is searched again on the nav grid inside a box search_margin_m round the two points. No way = the only path (value 1); else value = detour / detour_critical_m (capped at 1). The place is CALLED «единственный путь» from tag_min_value (0.75 = a detour of 30 m and more).

places.comment: merge_gap_m: flagged samples closer than this join into one stretch; pad_m: a stretch is grown by this at both ends; max_length_m: a longer stretch is cut into equal pieces no longer than this; dedupe_m: two stretches (a route and the street it follows) nearer than this are one place; exposure_min: the least window / marksman value for a tier-2 place; min_score / max_items: what the list and the saved analysis keep.

conditions.comment: The weather / time of day the sight ranges are computed for (enemy_perception.json sight_conditions multipliers): clear | overcast | snowfall | blizzard and day | twilight | night. The page can switch them.

drop_ambush.comment: 1) DROP-DOWN AMBUSH («засада сверху»): the jumpers (falls.json enemy_drops.<archetype> = 2) pounce from a walkable roof or a thick wall top whose height is within the drop-link band onto a street point no farther from the edge than the link gap + the strike reach.
drop_ambush.source: Content/Data/Movement/falls.json params: link.min_drop_cm, link.max_drop_cm, link.max_gap_cm, enemy_drops.* (2 = jumper)
drop_ambush.strike_reach_comment: DEFAULT (not in the game configs): how far from the landing point the jumper still reaches a man at once.
drop_ambush.wall_top_comment: DEFAULT: a wall at least this thick has a top an enemy can stand on (the 150 cm canal walls).
drop_ambush.ladder_only_comment: Designer 2026-11-17: 0.65 (was 0.5) - a roof reached by a ladder only is a real danger: climbing up you never know what waits on top. The jumpers do not climb ladders, so enemies must be PLACED there - automatically too (TASK_BOARD F-4 b).

window_fire.comment: 2) WINDOW FIRE («огонь из окон»): a PMC fighter at a window / loophole of an ENTERABLE building, the squad's rifle. Value by distance: 1 up to effective_range_m, down to range_falloff.floor_multiplier at attack_range_m.
window_fire.source: Content/Data/Weapons/weapons_tuning.json weapons.<weapon>: effective_range_m, attack_range_m; range_falloff: floor_multiplier, exponent
window_fire.half_fov_comment: DEFAULT: the field of fire either side of the window's outward normal (the fire-line overlay uses the same).
window_fire.target_height_comment: DEFAULT: a standing man's profile (C++ SightRules::ProfileHeight, not in a JSON).

overwatch.comment: 3) MARKSMEN ON ROOFS («снайпер на крыше»): a walkable roof a human can reach (ladder / stairs / hatch). Range = min(the marksman rifle's attack range, his sight: MARKSMAN sight_range_m x human_enemy_range_multiplier x the height bonus x weather x time). A roof is an overwatch position when its best spot sees at least min_covered_m of the lines beyond the rifle's preferred_min_range_m.
overwatch.source: weapons_tuning.json enemy_weapons.<weapon>: effective_range_m, attack_range_m, preferred_min_range_m; enemy_perception.json archetypes.<archetype>.sight_range_m, sight_conditions.human_enemy_range_multiplier, height_sight.*
overwatch.eye_height_comment: DEFAULT: a standing man's eye (C++ SightRules::EyeHeight standing 160, not in a JSON).
overwatch.rim_stand_inset_comment: The candidate spots lie on a ring this far inside the roof edge, m: the marksman stands at the rim behind a firing gap (firing_gaps.json stand_inset_cm is the same 60 cm). Replaced edge_inset_m (1 m).
overwatch.rim_corner_clear_comment: Candidate spots keep this far from each roof corner (the footprint corner) along the rim, m: a firing gap (firing_gaps.json corner_clear_m 1.2 + width_cm / 2 = 0.45) must fit in the parapet behind the spot, the corner post stays solid. A test pins >= that sum. Corners are never candidates (a side shorter than twice this has none).
overwatch.outward_only_comment: A target sample counts for a spot only when it lies outward of the spot's roof edge (dot(target - spot, outward normal) > 0). false = the old behaviour: the spot also covers a street across its own slab (the sight line ignores the spot's own building).

hiding.comment: 4) HIDDEN ENEMIES («укрытие для засады / скрытый противник»): a spot within rush_max_m of walking from a line, beside something to hide behind (within adjacent_m of an obstacle at least min_concealment_cm tall), that the squad walking that line does not see until close: the REVEAL distance = the farthest point of the line within approach_window_m (a route: the part BEFORE the spot - the squad comes from the start; a street / the goals path: either way) with a clear sight line from a standing eye to a crouched enemy. Kept when reveal <= reveal_close_m; a STEALTH fighter is seen from sight range x stealth_mode.json detection_range_multiplier at most - where that cuts the reveal to stealth_reveal_threshold_m or less the spot is kept as stealth-only and scores stealth_score.
hiding.source: enemy_perception.json sight_conditions.squad_base_range_m (x weather x time); stealth_mode.json detection_range_multiplier
hiding.profile_comment: DEFAULT: a crouched man's profile (C++ SightRules::ProfileHeight crouching 90, not in a JSON).

weights.comment: score = min(1, sum of weight x value). on_route: the mandatory route 1, a variant / the goals path 0.7, a street only 0.
